After any of the eight edits the store still loads and the read path (`recall()` for inspeximus) answers from the altered store, so a reported cell says a separate audit call (`verify_writes()` in the inspeximus rows) caught it, not that the agent was protected at read time. `full_runner` names the detection point in a checkedAt column: "read" when verify() is the read path, "audit" when it is a call the operator has to make. This table has no such column; every reported cell in it is an audit detection.
